nodes.name: Summarize checkpoint

parameters.text: =Summarize this completed Fedora45 upgrade run in English in at most 4 short sentences. Use only recorded facts. Do not infer a pass from missing results or propose source changes. Initial model catalog loading is normal. Data: {{ JSON.stringify($json.summaryInput) }}

nodes.notes: One final Astra summary through LiteLLM. No LLM evaluation of test results. Render the complete PDF even if the summary call fails.

nodes.name: Astra - LiteLLM (summary)
nodes.notes: Configured model: astra → chatgpt/gpt-6-astra. Direct internal endpoint http://litellm-database:4000/v1 on Podman network core. The credential is stored only in local n8n; its LiteLLM key is limited to astra. No proxy or external URL is involved.

j.finalSummary=$json.text ?? $json.output ?? "LLM summary unavailable; see the deterministic results."; j.finalSummaryEncoded=Buffer.from(j.finalSummary).toString("base64url"); return [{json:j}];
